source: libmonet_gdt wallpaper_shapes/bin/shapes.dart, arm echoes_split_noul, sheet options_o0
wallpaper_image: PNG; scale = min(1, 1024/width, 1568/max side); if short side * scale < 280 then scale = 280/short side; round (wallpaper_shapes/lib/image_fit.dart)
ref: first 16 hex chars of the request id; any stable 16-char string per request

assets.shape-{ref}-{key}: shape_images/<cells[key]>.png, one per key of options_o0.cells

questions: in this order, for each key k of options_o0.cells (file order): q_{k} = {type: noul, instructions: echoes.txt with {img} -> shape-{ref}-{k}}; then d_{k} = {type: noul, **clash_domain.json with {img} filled}; then t_{k} = {type: noul, **clash_tone.json with {img} filled}
score: shape score = q x (1 - d) x (1 - clamp((t - 0.7) / 0.3, 0, 1))
repeat_sheet: options_o1 (ADR D4): same 29 images, new question order and opaque keys; copied byte-identical from libmonet_gdt, record hash verified
